selection_boundary.selection_basis: static GitHub-hosted deployment/effort registry with physical response separation and source-code-declared focal taxon

source_identity.focal_rule: first exact taxon in the pinned source-code species_of_interest vector

deployment_registry.coordinate_rule: all retained raw deployments of one locationID must map to exactly one locationName and exactly one parsed finite longitude/latitude pair; no tolerance or averaging
deployment_registry.timestamp_rule: parse released deploymentStart/deploymentEnd with timezone offsets exactly as released; require start < end; never rewrite year or LE39
deployment_registry.interval_union: sort timezone-aware intervals by absolute instant; merge when next.start <= current.end
deployment_registry.eligible_effort_days: sum duration of the deterministic union in seconds divided by 86400
deployment_registry.baseline_camera_height_summary: median of finite numeric raw cameraHeight values across the location's deployments; missing if none
deployment_registry.baseline_deployment_group_summary: sorted unique non-empty deploymentGroups joined with |; explicit missing category if none

heldout_split.fold_rule: 1 + (big-endian integer from first 8 bytes of SHA-256(UTF-8 locationID) modulo 5)

world_geometry.distance_metric: Haversine great-circle distance on frozen WGS84 stable-location coordinates
world_geometry.threshold_population: all positive unordered pair distances among retained stable locations
world_geometry.edge_rule: undirected edge when Haversine distance <= threshold

baseline.covariate_join: exact locationName only; duplicate covariate locationName is a STOP; absent optional covariate row maps to explicit missing categories

observation_semantics.effort_eligible_rule: stable location is a candidate only when its response-independent raw unioned deployment effort is at least 20 days
observation_semantics.positive_rule: at least one exact Capreolus capreolus observation maps to any frozen eligible raw deployment of the stable location
observation_semantics.negative_rule: zero exact focal observations map to otherwise frozen eligible raw deployment effort
observation_semantics.unsurveyed_rule: locations below the prospectively frozen effort threshold are absent from the candidate registry and are never encoded as zero
observation_semantics.zero_interpretation: recorded camera non-detection during frozen eligible camera effort, not biological absence or inability to colonize

layer_a.calibration_positive_evidence: all focal-positive calibration stable locations in the outer fold
layer_a.fixed_source_rule: lexicographically smallest calibration-positive stable locationID is the fixed source; remaining positives are compatibility evidence
